dep_lead: How JGates installs the project dependencies before the checks: the manager of each component and the private registries, kept in .jgates/dependencies.yml.
dep_managers_lead: JGates uses the manager the component declares; without a declaration, the one detection found in the lock files.
dep_managers_empty: No component with dependencies was found.
dep_managers_edit: Change the manager or the groups of a component in Workspace
dep_secret_note: A registry keeps only the URL and the NAME of the secret that holds the token (for example NPM_TOKEN). The token value is never written here and never shown on this screen; it comes from the stored keys or from the CI environment.
dep_missing: The file .jgates/dependencies.yml does not exist yet. It is optional: without it, dependencies come from the public registries.
